positions.sentence: Students must disclose or acknowledge any AI use in their submitted work.
Students must properly cite or attribute AI-generated content or AI tools they use in their work.
Students must include a statement or note explaining how and where they used AI, or document the process of use.
Students must clearly mark which parts of their work are their own and which parts AI generated.
Students must follow their instructor's or assignment's requirements for disclosing, documenting and citing AI use.
Students should acknowledge, disclose or be transparent about their AI use and how they used it.
Students should cite AI-generated content like any other source.
Students may use AI if the use is properly documented and credited.
Students must not submit AI-generated content or ideas without acknowledging or citing it.
Students must be able to explain how they used AI when asked.
Everyone in the university community must disclose or cite their AI use.
Everyone should be transparent about their AI use and cite or disclose it.
Community members should not hide or conceal their use of AI.
Instructors should tell students how they are to disclose, cite or acknowledge AI use.
Instructors may require students to disclose, cite or explain their AI use.
Instructors must give students guidance on how to cite or disclose AI use.
Administrators or unit policies must set up disclosure requirements and frameworks for AI use.
Policies state that transparency and citation of AI use are valued, describe norms and benefits, or note that minor uses may need no disclosure.
